interpretation: An early candidate-closure gap is an effective trajectory trigger in the R10 seed2026 witness: changing only one duplicate auxiliary candidate label after Guard changes50-pass failure to17-pass convergence. This is not a universal convergence proof.

Late45 growing updates all lose previous pivot rows; the old-rank Schur maxima exceed the unchanged cutoff. Strong hints do not retain unavailable pairs. Conditioning and finite-precision influence are not ruled out.
The auxiliary intervention is not promoted: importance relative L2 worsens33.1%, and R9 seed2026 regresses30 to50 passes. No production Guard, stopping condition or pivot policy changed.

Converged is compatible with a nonzero error at positive tolerance and even a large undetected error under finite default Guard sampling. Exactness or a global error guarantee requires additional premises and independent verification.
No timings from the diagnostic builds are used for performance claims.
